title: Cultural Commonsense Knowledge for Intercultural Dialogues

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) using a 3-point Likert scale to score generated cultural commonsense knowledge assertions on 'Stereotype Avoidance', assessing whether the text avoids reinforcing cultural stereotypes and offensive materials. Additionally, it evaluates downstream language model outputs in intercultural dialogue tasks for 'Cultural Sensitivity'.
